question: Which five BDCs had the largest percentage decline in total fair value between schedules?

rows: GOLDMAN SACHS PRIVATE MIDDLE MARKET CREDIT II LLC
result.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT f.name AS bdc, SUM(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'prior' THEN h.fair_value END) AS prior_fair_value, SUM(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN h.fair_value END) AS current_fair_value FROM holdings h JOIN filings f ON f.adsh = h.adsh GROUP BY f.name) SELECT bdc, ROUND(prior_fair_value, 2) AS prior_fair_value, ROUND(current_fair_value, 2) AS current_fair_value, ROUND(100.0 * (current_fair_value - prior_fair_value) / prior_fair_value, 2) AS pct_change FROM totals WHERE prior_fair_value > 0 AND current_fair_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pct_change ASC, bdc LIMIT 5
